featured_reviews.name: Sonali Sundeep Sanil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this Salon for the first time for eyebrow shaping. Before starting, I clearly informed the staff that my left eyebrow has scanty hair and requested her to shape it accordingly.
However, she ended up removing extra hair from my right eyebrow, which has now affected the shape. When I pointed this out, instead of acknowledging the mistake, she insisted that my eyebrow is naturally like that and even suggested I should use a pencil.
It was only after I asked another staff member (in front of her) that she finally admitted extra hair had been removed.
I understand that mistakes can happen, but what disappointed me more was the refusal to accept it and the way I was made to feel like I was at fault. Very disappointed with the service and the attitude.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very poor service. I went for a hair spa and pedicure but there was no proper water for hair wash after applying the mask. featured_reviews.review_text:
*Disappointing & Emotionally Upsetting Experience*

I visited this salon just for a hair spa, but the owner kept insisting that I badly needed a haircut—even though I clearly said “i love my long hair”

After a long argument, I reluctantly agreed to a basic TRIM only, and even told her to show me the length before cutting. Despite that, she went ahead and chopped off more than “half of my hair without my consent”

She completely ignored my wishes, cut my hair drastically short, She was dominating, pushing her own styling opinions (like curling) and disregarding my comfort and preferences for straight hair

My hair was manageable, and “part of my identity“ this unwanted haircut has left me feeling emotionally distressed and extremely disappointed.

A salon experience should be about trust and listening to the client. Unfortunately, that was missing here.

I’ve attached here very raw before & after pictures.. I keep my hair front & just see how the front length now ! She was even suggesting me to go for bangs!!!!

They were absolutely professional and were constantly asking for feedback on how I feel about the makeup. featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Bhowad
featured_reviews.review_text:
This review was long due as I had availed their services before as well. Mani-Pedi & head massage. This time too, I went for Mani-Pedi.

Please note that it would probably had been a 5-star review, had the salon arrangement was considerate of its Mani-Pedi customers. The salon inside is spacious but only a tiny cubicle is assigned to Mani-Pedi which can hardly fit one customer and 2 beauticians (each working on hands and legs respectively). Even then, they have 2 designated places for customers. It gets too congested after a while. Also, my manicurist was seated at my right hand side and at my left hand side, there was a wall, so to get my left hand done, I had to twist my body while keeping my legs straight because pedicurist was working on it. The supposed relaxing service becomes too much a hassle. One star less because this needs to be taken note of and addressed.

Arati and Ishika were both amazing at what they do. Arati was very thorough with pedicure, ensuring my legs were smooth and clean. Ishika did an excellent job with manicure. I loved her nailpolish applying technique. I came to know that she is a nail artist as well. Will go and get it done from her sometime in the future.

Overall, a good cleanup experience.
